text.tspan: AI may reduce candidate counts while increasing characterization per molecule
From molecule throughput to data density: a potential driver of life science tools demand
One experiment, one bit per molecule
What the model learns: will it bind
Everything else — stability, potency, manufacturability — is a guess
Same wet-lab campaign — nine measured properties per molecule
What the model learns: nine properties and how they trade off — developability and potency, not binding alone
Better training may need no new experiment
Add missing assays and biological diversity
Terminology — what each of the nine labels measures
off-rate; how long it stays bound
how much antibody the cell makes
where on the target it binds
Illustrative counts. Nine label types are not nine independent assays; richer data need not come at unchanged cost.
Sources: Jain et al., 2017; Arsiwala et al., 2025; van Niekerk et al., 2026. Mechanism illustration; definitions and links in SOURCES.md.
